prevention_notes: evidence package status must be updated after manual review + merge + push before acceptance
report.json must include canonical_branch / canonical_head / test_count / tests_passed when evidence checker requires them
CI green is required before chain-status acceptance update
The EvidenceChecker.check_completeness() method requires report.json status to be 'completed' or 'ready_for_merge_signoff' with merge proof
Future rounds should ensure report.json is updated at merge time, not deferred
